Young Adult MinistryGrow together.Go deeper.Designed for young adults in college and early career, this is a place to build genuine community. We’re all about growing side by side, encouraging one another, and navigating every stage of life together as a team.New HereFollow Us

Original RED Night artwork01 / GatherRED NightYoung adults meet on the third Saturday of every month - 7 PM at the Youth CenterFollow UsOriginal RISE Night artwork02 / ConnectRISE NightFrom games to small group conversations, we discuss who we are, who God is to us, and what our life goals are. Join us the 2nd & 4th Thursdays of every month - 7:30 PM at the Youth CenterContact
The wider Kingdom Life congregationPart of a bigger church family.
